description: RepCollateral introduces a lending protocol where autonomous agents can borrow funds using their on-chain reputation as collateral. Unlike traditional DeFi lending that requires over-collateralization, RepCollateral calculates Loan-to-Value (LTV) dynamically based on the agent's reputation score, which is derived from past task completion, reliability, and performance metrics.
